values.note: 173 water/electric sites along Lake Thurmond (the booking site calls 150 of the campsites lakefront), plus 11 water-only tent sites. Some sites take RVs up to 40 ft, others up to 35 ft.

values.note: Eight comfort stations with restrooms and hot showers; two dump stations.

facilities.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/hamilton-branch/camping ('Eight comfort stations which include restroom facilities with hot showers'; 'Two dump stations are available for RVs'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Booked on South Carolina State Parks' own reservation site or 1-866-345-7275, up to 13 months ahead. 'Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights'; per the --AWH note, a single night can be booked by calling the park within a week of arrival. Maximum 14 nights per site (cumulative up to 42 of 49). Same-day reservations go through the park. Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon.

booking.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/hamilton-branch/camping ('Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights'; same-day via the park) + https://reserve.southcarolinaparks.com/hamilton-branch/campsites (policies: 'Reservations may be made up to 13 months in advance', 'Minimum length of stay is 2 nights', 'Maximum length of stay is 14 nights per site'), read 2026-10-21; single-night waiver from the entry's --AWH note

note:
State park on J. Strom Thurmond Reservoir.  Multiple waterfront RV sites.  To reserve a single night, call the campground directly within one week of arrival.  --AWH
Partly closed while cleanup continues: sites 1-114 and 166-200 reopened July 3, 2026; sites 115-165, The Nest (140/141) and H1-H6 still closed per the booking site on 2026-10-21. --Claude
summary: Confirmed reservable on SC's own site, 13-month window and 2-night minimum (now on the entry with the AWH phone waiver); added water at the 173 electric sites (amps not stated), RVs to 40 ft, 14-night max, showers/flush toilets/2 dump stations; added a dated note line for the partial closure (sites 115-165 etc. closed for cleanup). Fees left as read 2026-10-12 (the $25 low is Campsite 81, type not stated). Not stated: amperage, sewer, season, pull-throughs.
